title: Regression Session
body: Rohan has a set of data points $$x_i$$ $$\in$$ $$R$$ and $$y_i$$ $$\in$$ $$R$$ for $$i$$ $$\in$$ $$\{1$$, $$...$$, $$n\}$$, $$and$$ $$wants$$ $$to$$ $$use$$ $$regression$$ $$on$$ $$inputs$$ $$x_i$$ to predict $$y_i$$ values. He decides to use the following model:\n$$\hat{y}_i $$=$$ \theta\ln(x_i**{2})$$ with $$\theta$$ $$\in$$ $$R$$
